title: Thomas Edison
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous American inventor. He was born in 1847 in Ohio. He worked very hard and made many inventions. One of his best inventions was the light bulb.

Edison also made the phonograph, which could record and play sound. He had a small laboratory in New Jersey. People called him the Wizard of Menlo Park. He thought that failure was a part of learning.

questions.text: Why did Edison probably keep trying after mistakes?
options: He wanted to become rich quickly
He did not like his laboratory
He believed failure helped him learn

questions.text: What can we infer about Edison's laboratory?
options: It was a place where he worked on inventions
It was a school for children

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates new devices or ideas
new things that someone has created for the first time
a room where scientists do experiments
a lack of success in doing something

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison, Amerikalı ünlü bir mucitti. 1847 yılında Ohio'da doğdu. Çok çalıştı ve birçok buluş yaptı. En iyi buluşlarından biri ampuldü.

Edison ayrıca sesi kaydedebilen ve çalabilen fonografı yaptı. New Jersey'de küçük bir laboratuvarı vardı. İnsanlar ona Menlo Park Sihirbazı derdi. Başarısızlığın öğrenmenin bir parçası olduğunu düşünüyordu.
